limitations: Korean neutral differences are numerical spelling differences, not five lexical mistakes.
Japanese sewing reference is a phrase, not a complete utterance; insertions are not necessarily recognition errors.
Knee case has no full reference; keyword presence is only a diagnostic.
These screening runs use recorded audio; they do not establish live Discord, caption, TTS, or population accuracy.

pi_production_path_conditions.native_worker: C API pipe, warmed with 3s synthetic silence before ready
pi_production_path_conditions.primary: actual SttTurnFinalizer 200ms end delay and 200ms silence; persistent primary with manual finalize
pi_production_path_conditions.replay: 20ms chunks at recorded audio rate, no Discord transport/caption/TTS

release_acceptance.reason: Only 1/3 Korean published-image trials applied refinement before deadline; no new Japanese recognition accuracy gain. Primary retention is not an accuracy improvement.

latency_diagnosis.conditions: Published image, same PCM/current production terms, real-time 20ms chunks, no reference text as recognition input, production refinement disabled during replay. Six predeclared trials per variant: KO, KO, JA sewing, KO, JA knitting, KO. No retries discarded.
latency_diagnosis.manual_finalize_status: Rejected experimental adapter only; not implemented in application. Kept original one-endpoint and primary acknowledgment requirements. 1/4 Korean completed; does not establish equal output to finish for all speech.

early_prefix_and_acoustic_context_202609.warmed_runtime_note: Both primary sessions first received 200ms silence and a finalized acknowledgment. Korean primary already had zero errors; those three completions are not accuracy gains. Runtime outcomes include the prior speaker.
measurement_preparation_failures: The native Opus decode method is read-only; PCM injection uses a test-only decoder constructor instead.

The isolated Runtime requires setAudioEnabled(false); otherwise its deliberately disabled TTS test double rejects silence-generated output. Five pre-target setup attempts were retained privately; no quality trial was removed.
